title: The Smoother textures
description: Adds realistic like textures to specific blocks.
body:
This resource pack re-textures specific blocks to modern textures such as Iron doors to look like automatic modern doors, smoother diorite and a solid navy blue colour to prismarine etc.
**(Not compatible with Sodium, but still works after Error message with Sodium)**
![Update 1.1 (most recent update) with all of the blocks.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bc4e339ec3e06c0be06a4e5e28abee0c92d2952d_0.webp)
